label: EU-aiact-proceedings-2026 Article 12

obligations.text: Without prejudice to paragraph 2 of this Article, the time limits under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and this Regulation shall be calculated in accordance with Regulation (EEC, Euratom) No 1182/71.

By way of derogation from paragraph 1 of this Article, time periods shall begin running on the working day following the event to which the relevant provision of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 or this Regulation refers.
